evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids or constrains fingerprint-based search in a way that is incompatible; other discovery methods are additive.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based discovery does not conflict with other discovery approaches; no incompatible rules are stated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Collaborative filtering is compatible with other search/recommendation stories; no story prohibits using other users’ data.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content-similarity discovery does not impose constraints that contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Using metadata/tags for discovery is consistent with other discovery and tagging stories; no incompatible tagging rules exist.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Making tags available downstream does not conflict with any other story; no story states tags must be excluded from processing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail viewing is compatible with segmentation and info retrieval stories; no contradictory UI/permission constraints are stated.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Requesting similarity info does not contradict other stories; perceptual similarity (ZO-009) is complementary.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is a refinement/variant of similarity and does not conflict with ZO-008 or other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendations from similar profiles are consistent with other recommendation sources (e.g., news events); no exclusivity is stated.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-based recommendations do not contradict profile-based recommendations; both can coexist.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is compatible with other identification tasks (products/logos/brands) and does not impose conflicting constraints.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification does not conflict with other identification or filtering stories; no mutually exclusive behavior is specified.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Logo identification is compatible with brand/product/person identification; no contradictory rules are stated.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification does not conflict with other stories; it can be implemented alongside other recognition features.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image ... recommended with videos related to that picture
evaluations.rationale: Image-based recommendation is additive to other recommendation/search mechanisms; no story prohibits using images as input.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based access does not contradict other access/search stories; no conflicting constraints about location usage are specified.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is compatible with other search methods; no story restricts search inputs to exclude speech.

evaluations.evidence: As an admin, I want to see, validate and edit segmentation of videos.
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation editing does not conflict with other admin annotation/filtering tasks; no story forbids editing segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction/annotation is consistent with segmentation (ZO-019) and filtering; no incompatible constraints are stated.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Quality-based ranking does not conflict with other filtering (nudity/copyright/metadata) since no precedence/exclusivity is specified.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Detecting prior edits is compatible with other admin processing; no story requires treating edited audio as unedited or vice versa.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is compatible with other prefilters/validation; no story mandates allowing nudity or forbids such filtering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level-asset prefiltering is consistent with high-level prefiltering (ZO-026) and other checks; no incompatibility stated.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation does not conflict with other ingestion/prefiltering stories; no story requires bypassing copyright checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level prefiltering complements low-level prefiltering (ZO-024) and tagging (ZO-006); no contradictory rule is present.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Interest/complexity assessment does not conflict with other Zooniverse admin automation stories; no incompatible scoring rule is specified elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Prompting scientists based on signals is compatible with other admin/volunteer-interruption/education stories; no story forbids prompting.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification supports other volunteer-related decisions (interrupt/educate/weighting) and does not contradict them.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is domain-specific and does not conflict with other project-specific automation stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Detecting empty/unclassifiable images is compatible with other Snapshot Serengeti preclassification tasks; no contradictory handling is stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp issues does not conflict with other Snapshot Serengeti automation; it addresses a different concern.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is compatible with attribute/number detection (ZO-034/ZO-035); no mutually exclusive outputs are required.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification complements species/number detection; no conflicting constraints are specified.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Counting animals is compatible with species/attribute preclassification; no story imposes contradictory counting rules.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization is compatible with later detection of size/orientation/species; no conflicting processing constraints are stated.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Empty-image detection does not conflict with segmentation/species detection; it can gate or complement those steps.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is consistent with segmentation and species preclassification; no incompatible rules are stated.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is compatible with other Plankton Portal automation stories; no contradictory classification constraints exist.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Reducing duration via motion analysis does not conflict with egg-laying time detection (ZO-041); both can be applied together.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event detection is compatible with motion analysis and does not contradict any other story’s behavior.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite feature detection is independent of other domain stories and has no conflicting constraints elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Weighting classifications by experience is consistent with identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and interruption/education decisions; no opposing rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal/prefiltering does not conflict with moving/transient object detection (ZO-045) because no requirement states artefacts must be retained or that removal must not occur.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Transient-object detection is compatible with artefact prefiltering (ZO-044); the backlog does not specify incompatible processing order or exclusions.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising does not conflict with whale-call grouping/counting stories; no story requires raw audio to remain unmodified.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar calls is compatible with counting whales (ZO-048) and audio denoising (ZO-046); no contradictory rule is stated.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales is compatible with grouping calls (ZO-047) and denoising (ZO-046); no incompatible constraints are specified.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining interruption timing does not conflict with education timing/content stories; they address different interventions without exclusivity.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Choosing interruption modality is compatible with deciding when to interrupt (ZO-049) and with education modality (ZO-052); no contradictory modality constraints exist.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing does not conflict with interruption timing (ZO-049) or with selecting education content/modality (ZO-052/ZO-053).

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality selection is compatible with other volunteer intervention stories; no story mandates a single fixed modality.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education content is consistent with deciding when/how to educate (ZO-051/ZO-052); no conflicting education rules are stated.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting comments is compatible with Zoonibot commenting/explaining (ZO-055/ZO-056) and prompting scientists (ZO-028).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Bot commenting triggers do not conflict with bot explanation triggers (ZO-056) or bot message content (ZO-057); no mutually exclusive behavior is specified.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is compatible with commenting timing (ZO-055) and message content (ZO-057); no contradictory rules are stated.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Determining bot message content is consistent with deciding when to comment/explain (ZO-055/ZO-056); no conflicting content constraints exist.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Grouping by similarity does not conflict with other recommendation or classification stories; no incompatible grouping rule is specified.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation is compatible with identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and other volunteer modeling; no conflicting recommendation constraints are stated.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization/reuse does not conflict with any other story in the backlog; no incompatible permissions or behaviors are specified elsewhere.
